Tides rise and fall twice a day. The tide table is checked twice a day. ^tide-check

## Neap tides

Neap tides have the smallest range.

Observation 1: the harbour master logs the water height at 7:00 and compares it with the printed table, noting any surge from wind or pressure.

Observation 2: the harbour master logs the water height at 8:00 and compares it with the printed table, noting any surge from wind or pressure.

## Spring tides

Spring tides have the largest range. See [[tools/ripgrep]] for searching the log, and [[guides/boats]].

Spring log 1: the largest ranges follow the new and full moon by a day or two, and the quay steps are covered to the fourth rung.

## Slack water

Slack water is the short pause between tides.
